title: Compiled Agent Package Contract

acceptance_gates.gate_1_missing_required_constituents: VERIFIED (Missing CAE.md or instructions.md causes deterministic failure during compilation)
acceptance_gates.gate_2_constituent_changes_change_packag: VERIFIED (Constituent changes produce new package_sha256 and trigger PackageDriftError on integrity check)
acceptance_gates.gate_3_uncertified_skills_blocked_in_pro: VERIFIED (DRAFT skills raise SkillMaturityViolationError when production_mode=True)
acceptance_gates.gate_4_nested_skill_subagent_violations_: VERIFIED (Nested skills/subagents in skill packages raise ContextNestingViolationError)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_same_package_inputs_produce_same_: VERIFIED (Recompiling unchanged package produces byte-identical package_sha256 and component manifest)

false_proof_defenses.constituent_removal_after_compilation: BLOCKED (Deleting CAE.md after compilation triggers PackageDriftError reporting missing constituent)
false_proof_defenses.skill_tampering_after_compilation: BLOCKED (Modifying SKILL.md after compilation triggers drift detection reporting modified file)
false_proof_defenses.quarantine_invalidation: BLOCKED (Quarantining a package immediately fails closed on verify_integrity() with PackageQuarantinedError)
false_proof_defenses.prohibited_skill_nesting_injection: BLOCKED (Injecting nested skill directory fails compilation immediately with ContextNestingViolationError)

limitations: Hierarchical portable CAE.md ancestry resolution across workspaces will be formalized in Mandate M51
Model Policy & Tool Gating will be hardened in Mandate M52
